skill.name: research-agent-optimization
skill.description: Optimize research agent reliability with rate-limit handling, API call batching, DuckDuckGo search fixes, streaming progress updates, and source attribution.
skill.summary: Guide backend and frontend changes that make research agents faster, clearer, and more resilient.
skill.author: BenderFendor

security_audit.summary: All 32 static findings were reviewed against SKILL.md. The backtick and reconnaissance alerts are false positives from Markdown formatting, file names, and validation checklist text. One low-severity issue remains because the skill exposes an absolute local project path.

remediation.issue: Hardcoded local project path in marketplace instructions
remediation.suggestion: Replace `/home/bender/classwork/Thesis` with a generic project-root placeholder and explain how users should map it to their repository.

static_findings.snippet: - Add optional `--skip-gemini-analysis` mode for article analysis when quota is low
- Set model to `gemini-2.0-flash` (faster, lower token cost) instead of `gemini-2.0-flash-exp`
- Verify DuckDuckGo import: `from duckduckgo_search import DDGS` (not `ddgs` or `DuckDuckGo`)
- Ensure `web_search` and `news_search` tools are properly bound to LLM
- Use `exa-code` to verify current DuckDuckGo API patterns
- Expand SSE event types: `tool_start` includes tool name + query parameters
- [ ] Implement request cache in `search_internal_news` with 5min TTL
- [ ] Update `research_stream()` to emit granular tool start/result events
- Add caching layer for semantic search results (avoid duplicate queries within 5min window)
- Submit invalid query and verify doesn't crash

content.value_statement: Research agents can waste API quota and show unclear progress. This skill guides batching, rate limits, streaming updates, and source rendering.
actual_capabilities: Identifies where to add semantic search caching and request batching.
Defines graceful handling for Gemini 429 quota errors.
Specifies DuckDuckGo DDGS initialization checks for web and news search.
Maps backend tool events to clear streaming status messages.
Plans source-card rendering for frontend research results.
Lists validation checks for quota, search, streaming, and UI behavior.
limitations: Does not include implementation files, patches, or automated tests.
Assumes the target app uses the listed backend and frontend file paths.
Requires current Gemini and DuckDuckGo API behavior to be verified separately.
Does not manage provider quotas outside the application code.

use_cases.title: Stabilize AI Research Features
use_cases.description: Use the checklist to reduce duplicate API calls and handle quota failures more clearly.

use_cases.title: Plan Quota-Aware Search Workflows
use_cases.description: Turn agent reliability goals into backend tasks for batching, caching, and provider error handling.

use_cases.title: Improve Research Result Presentation
use_cases.description: Convert raw response output into source cards, readable progress states, and user-friendly errors.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Current Agent
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my research agent against this skill. Identify rate-limit, web search, streaming, and source-rendering gaps before editing files.

prompt_templates.title: Handle Rate Limits
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to add quota-aware error handling, retry backoff, and clear user messages for Gemini rate-limit failures.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Streaming UX
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the streaming guidance from this skill. Map tool activity into clear progress events and readable frontend status messages.

prompt_templates.title: Apply Full Optimization Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill as an implementation plan. Update backend search behavior, rate-limit handling, streaming events, source rendering, and validation checks.

output_examples.input: I need to reduce Gemini quota errors in my research agent.
output_examples.output: The assistant recommends request batching, semantic result caching, exponential backoff, and a user message for quota exhaustion.

output_examples.input: My search page shows raw JSON instead of useful article sources.
output_examples.output: The assistant plans a readable answer with a Sources section, article cards, and duplicate source removal.

output_examples.input: Web search returns no results during research sessions.
output_examples.output: The assistant checks DuckDuckGo DDGS initialization, confirms tool binding, and defines fallback behavior to internal search.

best_practices: Verify provider API behavior before changing search tool bindings.
Log quota and tool failures with request IDs, not user secrets.
Test streaming, errors, caching, and source rendering together.
anti_patterns: Do not retry quota errors indefinitely or hide failures behind generic messages.
Do not show raw JSON blocks when users expect a readable research answer.
Do not assume one project path or provider model fits every deployment.

faq.question: Does this skill run commands?
faq.answer: No. It is a Markdown guide for implementation tasks and validation checks.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: It is marked for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it fix rate limits automatically?
faq.answer: No. It tells the assistant where to add batching, caching, backoff, and user messages.

faq.question: Can it help with DuckDuckGo search failures?
faq.answer: Yes. It describes DDGS import checks, tool binding, result logging, and fallback behavior.

faq.question: Does it include frontend work?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers streaming status messages, source cards, article modals, and error retry UI.

faq.question: What should I verify after using it?
faq.answer: Check quota handling, cache hits, web search results, SSE events, source de-duplication, and user-facing errors.
